text:
Zoe: quick recap from today's usability checks on the playground invoke flow. biggest issues: toolbar actions are ambiguous (users unsure if Run/Preview targets a single function or the entire invocation) and icon-only controls are being skipped by keyboard users.
Sam: saw that. proposal: keep short verb label on button (Run / Preview) and add a tiny scope indicator pill next to it that says 'selection' or 'all'. on narrow widths collapse the pill to a chevron.
Ibrahim: accessibility requirements: icon-only 16px buttons are not enough. need: 1) aria-labels describing the scope (e.g., aria-label="Run highlighted function"), 2) hit target >=24px, 3) visible focus ring that meets 3:1. also respect prefers-reduced-motion for tooltips.
Maya: copy detail: change run history phrasing from 'Ran 3s ago' to 'Completed 3s ago' for finished runs; use 'Running (3s)' while active. testers misread past tense in timeline.
Zoe: UX compromise: visible labels stay short; the scope pill is the place to show scope text. tooltip on pill (aria-describedby) expands: 'Runs the selected function only. Click to toggle to all functions. Shortcut: Shift+Enter.'
Sam: implementation note: toolbar is inside Monaco iframe. we'll need a postMessage bridge to forward keyboard shortcuts and focus events. keep visible copy concise to avoid breaking layouts.
Ibrahim: run history state also uses color only. add an icon + compact text 'Succeeded'/'Failed' and an aria-live region that announces status flips. include data-state attribute for e2e checks.
Maya: placeholder in function-def editor: 'args: {}' reads as required; change to 'Example args: {"q":"weather in sf"}' plus muted helper 'JSON or YAML examples accepted' and a small 'Insert example' affordance.
Sam: add instant linting: quick green check for passing schema, red underline + tooltip for errors. debounce linting around 300ms to avoid noisy errors while typing.
build-bot: CI: PR 5901 preview deployed to staging/playground-invoke — all checks passed.
Ibrahim: perf tip: lazy-load svg sprite after first 100ms post-render or after interaction with history list; for very long lists, render simple text chips first then replace with icons when in viewport.
Maya: a11y modal flow: when tool-calling modal opens focus must go to first tabbable element, trap focus, Escape closes modal and returns focus to trigger, and role="dialog" + aria-modal should be present. I'll add automated checks.
Zoe: plan: split into two PRs — PR A: a11y infra (aria labels, focus trap, aria-live) + postMessage bridge; PR B: copy + tooltips + placeholder + svg lazy-load + inline linting.
Sam: can someone own final strings? @Maya want to draft the tooltip/pill text and placeholder examples and push to staging by EOD tomorrow? I'll hook up the postMessage bridge and focus behavior.
Maya: will do. i'll include aria-describedby ids and sample JSON. will run axe and keyboard walkthrough on staging.
Ibrahim: tagging eng-runtime in case we need a small run-scope flag in the trace metadata for previews.
Zoe: summary: short visible verbs + scope pill, explicit 'Completed' wording in history, icons+text+aria-live for statuses, placeholder examples, inline linting, a11y modal semantics, copy owner @Maya, CI green. thanks all :clap:
